name: Shirohara Sanae
source:
Proprietress of Hinawari Onsen and a married woman.

She is a neat, gentle, and graceful woman. She is a devoted person, and will make every effort to do as she is asked.

She has a masochistic sexual preference, and when pressed, she is a dangerous woman who is easily seduced.
